name: dsv3_fused_a_gemm
description: dsv3_fused_a_gemm(mat_a, mat_b) -> out. mat_a has shape [m, k] and mat_b has shape [k, n]. Compute out = (mat_a.float() @ mat_b.float()) cast to mat_a.dtype, returning a newly allocated [m, n] tensor. mat_b may be column-major or otherwise strided; the native implementation uses the supplied A/B strides. Several m-dependent Triton paths are selected, including GEMV, shared-B, transposed, and CTA-aligned paths. No input is mutated. The exercised inputs are bfloat16 with k in the 4096 and 7168 range and n in the 1536 and 2112 range.
